title: Rank research conclusions by uncertainty sensitivity
question: Which claimed effects change most when uncertain reading and spacing policies are varied?
rationale: A sensitivity ranking could prioritize the image loci whose reinspection would most improve confidence.
distinctness: Combines available alternative-reading annotations with effects already present in the baseline, rather than simply requesting another transcription.

prior_work_check.scope: Bounded launch-source catalog and current seed directions inspected; this does not establish world-first novelty.

first_step: Calculate effect ranges for the three frozen baseline variants and identify the responsible locus set.
limitations: Candidate suggestion only; detailed protocol and execution are future work.
Designated seed: zero competitive allocations; evidence-tier baseline awaits official assessment.
